note: Reviewed CDB90 match 42, pinned revision e0b35ec4d798cec3bb4e6970c0f6bb7aa69e2f4c. CDB90 (CAA Database of Battles, Version 1990), tidy data maintained by Jeffrey B. Arnold. Original US Army Concepts Analysis Agency data; revised data licensed ODC-BY. Original force designations and strength interpretations are retained with each quantity. Each side is one aggregate force, including any coalition; its total is not allocated among members. Personnel casualties are not deaths. Source estimates and adjudged error margins are not statistical confidence intervals. Equipment and tactical movements are not established by this dataset. Match review: The Rijksmuseum battle map identifies 1 July 1690, Luxembourg's French army and Waldeck's allied army. Both complete source forces remain local. The catalogue's Kingdom of England participant cannot represent the full ALLIED ARMY coalition. Identity review (attacker; original CDB90 name FR ARMY): CDB FR ARMY / LUXEMBOURG corresponds to the French field army named on the historical map. Identity review (defender; original CDB90 name ALLIED ARMY): CDB ALLIED ARMY is the complete coalition shown opposite Luxembourg in the Rijksmuseum map. Its total is not assigned to England or any other one member.
